latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of Maker Free, a cloud-based video creation and export tool for fast, free editing.
- Supports uploading raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generating finished 1080p MP4 videos with music and transitions using simple prompts.
- Anonymous login with 100 free credits (valid for 7 days); automatic backend setup and session management.
- Handles video processing, editing instructions, downloads, and format conversions via cloud GPU.
- Includes transparent error handling, status updates, and detailed API mappings for common workflows.
